description: [GA4 WRITE] Update an audience (only displayName/description are mutable; filters are immutable). Pass only the fields to change; updateMask is derived from them (override with an explicit updateMask for nested paths). Requires GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

body.description: Raw request-body object (JSON) merged OVER the typed fields — use for nested/advanced fields not exposed as flat args.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

name.description: Full resource name of the audience to target: "properties/{property}/audiences/{id}".

updateMask.description: Comma-separated field paths to update. Omit to derive from the supplied fields.

name: ga4_update_audience
